facts.accept_usage: usage: facts.py --accept <key> <bare value> <replay command> <source> — manually register one fact (it lands in the ledger; the same replay gate then runs its cmd verbatim)
facts.bad_bare_min: REFLECT_NAKED_MIN=%(value)r is not an integer ⇒ using the default %(default)d
facts.bare_number_unaccounted: line %(line)d has a number %(number)s with **no provenance** — it is not in the ledger and has no [[key]] citation / provenance marker. Either measure it into the ledger (with a replay command) and cite it, or confirm it is a harmless shape (version / port / date)
facts.block_consistent: the machine block of %(path)s matches a fresh render
facts.block_mismatch: the block in the document does not match the ledger ⇒ run `python3 zreflect/facts.py --render-doc`
facts.block_stale: the %(begin)s block of %(path)s does not match a fresh render ⇒ run --render-doc
facts.copied_value: line %(line)d has a bare number %(value)s (belongs to `%(key)s`) ⇒ rewrite it as [[%(key)s]]
facts.doc_has_no_home: document `%(path)s` is not in the machine-block home table (known: %(known)s) — 'nothing to check' is not 'nothing is stale'
facts.doc_missing: document does not exist: %(path)s — a missing file must not count as a pass (zero-value guard)
facts.doc_missing_check: document %(path)s does not exist (--check must not pass just because the file is missing)
facts.doc_missing_render: %(path)s does not exist. Place the machine-block markers by hand once.
facts.doc_unreadable: doc unreadable: `%(path)s` (%(error)r) — bad encoding / permissions / a directory are config accidents, not 'stale block'
facts.doc_unwritable: cannot write the doc: `%(path)s` (%(error)r) — read-only / permissions / full disk are environment accidents, not 'stale block'
facts.empty_ledger: ledger is empty — empty is not a pass (zero-value guard): check whether measure_example() is broken
facts.init_env_exists_in_hooks: `reflect-hooks/Einfacht.env` already exists ⇒ not creating a second one at the repo root (the plugin reads the hooks dir first; two copies would let the hooks read A while you source B)
facts.ledger_missing: fact ledger (%(name)s) is missing. Run python3 zreflect/facts.py to measure first.
facts.ledger_unreadable: ledger unreadable: `%(path)s` (%(error)r) — a corrupt file is not 'no ledger'; it must be fixed
facts.ledger_why: fact ledger: each entry = a **measured** value + replay command + source. Do not edit by hand; run zreflect/facts.py.
facts.marker_swallowed_body: %(path)s has the marker literal mixed into the prose (%(begin)s) — rendering would swallow the block; refusing to write; markers may appear only at the block's ends
facts.markers_missing_render: %(path)s is missing the %(begin)s / %(end)s markers (place them by hand once on first rollout)
facts.measure_bad_shape: `measure()` returned %(count)d malformed entries: %(keys)s — every value must have the shape produced by `ledger.fact()`. %(hint)s
facts.measure_module_where: the module must be importable from `zreflect/` (put it inside `zreflect/`, or set PYTHONPATH); if you are not sure it works, leave this knob unset
facts.measure_own_code_hint: this repo has %(dirs)s — that is **your** code, while the numbers above measure the toolkit itself. To measure your own project: set REFLECT_MEASURE_MODULE=<your module> in Einfacht.env (the module defines a measure() returning a dict of fact())
facts.measure_placeholder_used: measure_example() used; set REFLECT_MEASURE_MODULE for real repo (changing repos edits one line in Einfacht.env; falling back to the placeholder leaves the ledger empty)
facts.measure_shape_hint: write it as `from ledger import fact` then `return {"key": fact(value, "replay command", "source")}` — a bare value like `{"key": 12}` is rejected
facts.missing_key_cite: line %(line)d cites a key that does **not exist**: `%(key)s`
facts.no_block_markers: document has no %(begin)s / %(end)s markers — not finding the block is not the same as the block being correct (zero-value guard)
facts.no_ledger_yet:
no ledger yet at %(name)s (path = REFLECT_FACTS, currently resolved to %(path)s)
       first confirm this repo's ledger path: check what REFLECT_FACTS is set to in Einfacht.env / the facts wrapper script,
       then run the measurement with the same environment: python3 zreflect/facts.py (a bare run uses code defaults — the target may differ from the hook context)
       then run --render-doc to write the machine block into the document.
facts.note.bare_number_demo: deliberately ≥100, to demonstrate the bare-number rule
facts.note.excludes_machine_block: excludes machine blocks: they are rendered into the documents, counting them would make the value go stale on every render
facts.note.measure_or_omit: if it cannot be measured it is not written — absent beats fake
facts.ok: Facts gate: OK (%(count)d facts; block consistent, no bare numbers, no bad citations)
facts.registry_mismatch:
registry reconciliation failed, refusing to render:
  · %(entries)s
facts.render_unchanged: the machine block of %(path)s is unchanged
facts.title: Facts gate
facts.unknown_command: unknown command `%(command)s` — run `--help` for the available ones (it measures nothing and writes nothing)
facts.usage: usage: facts.py [--render|--render-doc [file]|--check [file]|--get KEY|--init|--accept-principles|--accept KEY VALUE CMD SOURCE|show [KEY]] (no argument = measure and write the ledger)
